changes.description: Upgrades TEEProverRegistry from version 0.5.0 using the legacy Nitro verifier to version 0.6.1 using the hinted Nitro validator. Owner, manager, signers, per-signer image hashes, proposers and game type remain unchanged.

Sets gameImpls[621] to the redeployed AggregateVerifier (version 0.2.0), replacing the previous verifier. The new verifier is bound to the existing ProtocolVersions registry and carries the v1.4.2 Cobalt proof hashes.

Raises minimumProtocolVersion from v1.4.1 to v1.4.2. The format packs the low 16 bytes as major || minor || patch || pre-release, four bytes each, so v1.4.2 is 0x00000001000000040000000200000000 (79228162588051313896972091392).
